title: Safe Classic fallback after invalid learned-policy output
description: Two consecutive 5 Hz intents for one learned_policy participant on a 12 m section at Racer difficulty. The policy's actor produced nonfinite output at tick 1000, so the safety layer replaced the proposed intent wholesale with safe Classic control and a visible diagnostic (OPPONENT_AI.md fault path), and the substitution is recorded in safety.emergency rather than as a field correction. The second intent records that the replacement persists, which BENCHMARKS.md counts as a learned failure rather than a successful learned finish; this fixture records the representation of that telemetry, not a measured outcome, and claims no trained model exists (producer_revision is a placeholder and is listed in unknowns). Status 'example': the learned_policy producer kind is exercised to prove the shared contract admits it. The first record's source observation obs.t000996.ai_surge_1 resolves (12 m road width, Racer difficulty, surge style, 12-tick traffic age); the second record's source_observation_id (obs.t001008.ai_surge_1) is an illustrative reference to an observation record that is not shipped as an observation fixture, so only the first record has a participant/tick pairing that can be verified against the observation slice.

lateral.note: Corridor half-width is (12.0 - 1.8)/2 - 0.5 m = 4.6 m; the safe Classic control recenters the line at 0.0 m.

pace.note: Decoding the racer desired speed-profile interval is unratified; see unknowns.

commitment.label: follow
commitment.note: -0.6 is below -1/3, so the executed label is follow; no pass commitment is active.

drift.label: retain
drift.note: Between the drift thresholds, so the decode band is retain; the safe Classic control runs a grip preference.

interventions.note: Per-tick safety held the safe Classic line at tick 1000, the tick the invalid output was detected; no field correction was needed because the whole intent was replaced.

emergency.reason: nonfinite actor output at tick 1000; safe Classic control took over with a visible diagnostic

safety.note: A wholesale replacement is recorded in safety.emergency, not as a correction entry.

lateral.note: The safe Classic control keeps the recentered line at 0.0 m.

emergency.reason: the invalid output persisted, so safe Classic control continues; the substitution tick is recorded inside this intent's own hold window

safety.note: persistent is true because the same substitution continues the previous intent's; BENCHMARKS.md counts such a run as a learned failure, not a learned finish.

expectations.statement: The recentered fallback target decodes to 0.0 m inside the corridor with no correction.
The continuing fallback target also decodes to 0.0 m inside the corridor with no correction.
A wholesale replacement carries substituted true with a kind, a tick inside the hold window and a reason, and it is not persistent because it is the first intent of the run.
The second intent continues the same classic_fallback substitution, so persistent is true and the tick lies inside its own hold window.
A classic_fallback on a learned_policy producer is legal; the same kind on a classic_planner producer is rejected.
The single per-tick override tick 1000 lies inside the first intent's hold window [996, 1008).
The fallback executes follow with no active pass commitment, so commit_started_tick is null throughout.
The retain band keeps a grip preference as the executed preference; history is valid, so it is not 'none'.
The racer speed-profile interval is null (unratified until M4.3), so no target speed is determined and no pace correction may appear.
Consecutive intents are 12 ticks apart at the 5 Hz tactical rate on a 60 Hz tick.
intent_age_ticks equals sampled_tick minus generated_tick.
The second intent's age arithmetic is consistent.
Racer difficulty uses the 12-tick delayed traffic snapshot.
The second intent carries the same difficulty traffic age.
Record difficulty, style, producer kind and revision match the fixture context.
The second record also matches the fixture context.
Hazard checks are never deferred, including while a fallback substitution runs.
The first intent's source observation obs.t000996.ai_surge_1 resolves and agrees on participant, tick, difficulty, style, traffic age, reset generation, history validity, route frame and road width.
The second intent's source observation is declared illustrative because the observation slice ships no such record.
The intent carries the 0.4 s minimum commitment constant even while following.
Every declared metric is a documented initial target or an explicit undecided requirement; no fixture metric claims a measured status.
Each metric's bound members match its comparator: threshold comparators carry value, range/ratio_range carry ordered value_min/value_max, report carries no bound.
Every null that means 'not yet determined' has a matching unknowns entry.

comparison.purpose: Document the standing intervention targets the fallback telemetry feeds, plus the requirement that persistent Classic replacement counts as a learned failure.

illustrative_sources.reason: The observation slice ships no obs.t001008.ai_surge_1 record; the second intent's source observation is illustrative only and follows the observation contract's obs.t<tick>.<participant> convention. Nothing further is claimed about it.

unknowns.reason: The racer desired speed-profile interval is tuned at M4.3 and is not numerically specified by OPPONENT_AI.md.
Target speed cannot be decoded until the difficulty interval is ratified.
OPPONENT_AI.md requires holding 'a short commitment window' but does not fix its length.
Same unratified window length as records.0.
OPPONENT_AI.md requires interpolating intents but does not specify the curve.
Placeholder only: no learned policy revision is ratified yet. The fixture instantiates the producer kind to exercise the shared contract, not to claim a model exists.
Required behavior for an intent at or beyond the 12-tick staleness threshold (a missed 5 Hz update) is not specified.

The hold window [generated_tick, generated_tick + period_ticks) is this contract's modeling decision for tick-level safety exposure; OPPONENT_AI.md does not say whether a record exported at sampled_tick inside the window must truncate its intervention list.

The emergency kind vocabulary (emergency_stop, reset, classic_fallback) is provisional until the intervention categories are preregistered before evaluation (OPPONENT_AI.md 'Implementation and acceptance'); the metric itself is a later measured run.
